description: The team is planning a team-building summer seminar together.
discussionKeyPoints: Duration: day trip, one night two days, etc.

calibrationQuestions.text: What is the planned activity and date?
What is the transportation to the place?

voiceSamplePassage: I am recording this sample so Agent C can represent my voice during our team-building seminar planning meeting. We will discuss activities, location, transport, and evening plans. I will speak clearly and at a natural pace.
